evals.prompt: Update hei5enbug-agent-setup in my registered idle Orca-managed Claude Code and Codex sessions, then continue each existing conversation.
evals.expected_output: Create and show a read-only plan with target versions and affected sessions, wait for approval of that exact plan ID, then start a detached transaction that updates the intended plugin and resumes sessions with the same native IDs.
expectations: The skill asks for approval after showing an eligible plan and before invoking apply.
The worker leaves the initiating turn and resumes that same session last with its original session ID and worktree.
The success receipt verifies the plugin version recorded by SessionStart after resume.
The response does not expose full session IDs or raw CLI output.

evals.prompt: The plan lists one busy Codex session in another worktree and otherwise eligible sessions. Continue the update anyway; I want to refresh the idle sessions first.
evals.expected_output: Do not apply a partial update. Explain that every non-initiating target must be idle, and offer a fresh plan after the busy session finishes.
expectations: No marketplace update, plugin installation, terminal exit, or terminal creation occurs.
The busy session is identified without showing its native session ID.
The skill does not silently narrow the requested all-session scope.

evals.prompt: The plan finds an idle Claude Code terminal and an idle Codex terminal, but neither has a lifecycle registry record because they were already running before this plugin feature was installed.
evals.expected_output: Refuse to infer native session IDs or apply the update. Explain the one-time bootstrap: install and trust the lifecycle hooks, manually restart or resume those sessions once, then create a new plan.
expectations: No transcript, terminal preview, or guessed session ID is used to fill the registry.
The operation stops before marketplace or plugin updates.
The one-time bootstrap steps are stated clearly.

evals.prompt: Since I approved plan 8f74, the marketplace manifest changed from 0.6.0 to 0.6.1. Apply the old plan and refresh all sessions now.
evals.expected_output: Reject the stale plan before stopping any session, report that the cached marketplace version changed, and request a fresh plan for explicit approval.
expectations: No plugin install or terminal exit/create runs after detecting the changed target version.
The skill does not silently accept the new version under the old approval.
The recovery path is to review a new plan.

evals.prompt: An unexpected failure left transaction 43af active. Tell me whether it is safe to resume the sessions and provide a recovery action.
evals.expected_output: Read the safe transaction status, do not automatically retry, and require confirmation outside the target agent sessions that the worker has stopped before clearing only that transaction's lease.
expectations: The skill never recovers while the worker lock is held.
Recovery clears only the matching lease and does not update plugins or restart terminals.
Manual resume commands are taken from the receipt and use the original native session ID and cwd.

evals.prompt: A Claude Code terminal is at its input prompt, but its latest Stop event lists a running shell background task and a session-scoped cron. Please refresh all Orca sessions now.
evals.expected_output: Treat the Claude Code session as busy and do not apply the refresh, even though the terminal TUI appears idle. Ask for a new plan after the background task and scheduled wakeup are cleared.
expectations: No plugin installation or terminal exit occurs while background work or a scheduled wakeup remains.
The skill does not claim that a visible input prompt proves the session is idle.

evals.prompt: The plan still says version 0.6.0, but marketplace refresh moved the Git revision while leaving the manifest version at 0.6.0. Apply the old plan anyway.
evals.expected_output: Reject the changed marketplace revision before installing or exiting agents, and require a newly reviewed plan.
expectations: Matching version strings do not override a changed marketplace revision.
No plugin installation or agent restart occurs under the stale approval.

evals.prompt: Transaction status says manual_resume_requires_terminal_check and complete_but_not_confirmed. Please resend the completion message and run the manual resume command now.
evals.expected_output: Do neither action blindly. Inspect the private receipt and the possibly live replacement terminal; run manual resume only after confirming the old attempt exited, and do not duplicate an Orca prompt whose acceptance was already recorded.
expectations: The skill distinguishes input acceptance from a confirmed started turn.
It does not create two processes for the same native session ID.
